MY BESTFRIEND IS COMING TO LIVERPOOL!!! 🎉🎉🎉

@Lorna Villaruz got her NMC PIN today!!! She is now officially a registered nurse in the UK and I am so happy I cannot even type properly, my hands are shaking haha. Thank you Lord 🙏

For those who don't know, Lorna and me trained together in nursing school in Iloilo. Capping ceremony 1996, same hairstyle, same dream. In our dorm we polished our white shoes every single night and this one ALWAYS borrowed my polish. Never bought her own, not even once 😂 Lorna, you still owe me maybe ten tins, I am counting.

When I left for the UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and said susunod ako, I will follow you. Well. It only took her 22 years haha!! Almost 18 of those years she was working in Riyadh and then Dubai, and for 20 years I have been telling her come to Liverpool, come to Liverpool. Finally she listen to me 😂

She did her OSCE in Nottingham and I sent her a photo of the rain here so she knows what she is getting into. She still said yes, so she cannot complain later!!

Now the important dates, because I know you will all ask. She lands in Manchester on 14 January, around 1pm, and she starts work on 25 January on Ward 7. I am already counting the days like a child before Christmas. Ward 7, you are so lucky, you don't even know it yet. She is the best nurse I know and I am not saying it only because she is my bestfriend. So calm, nothing shakes her, and the patients love her everywhere she goes. You will see.

She will stay with us for the first month. The spare room is hers and Ben says ok (as if he has a choice hehe). I am already getting the heater and the thick duvet ready because I know she will freeze.

Lorna, listen to me now. Bring a PROPER coat. Not the one that was fine for Dubai. Liverpool wind is no joke, it goes right through you and then it comes back again for a second time 😂

And welcome to our Filipino family here!! You will just miss the party this December, but from next year you are with us for everything. The Christmas parties, the potluck with too much pancit, and Simbang Gabi next year with us, all nine nights, no excuses ha.

And yes, I am the sister from another mother, I know who I am 😘 I am so so proud of you. You said susunod ako and you did it. See you on 14 January, I will be the one screaming. Love you ❤️❤️❤️
